packs.title: Country checklists
packs.intro: For summits outside Taiwan: download the country’s GBIF species list and the species search finds its plants offline.
packs.scope: The web app asks GBIF for the plant kingdom only (GLORIA records vascular plants), which keeps the file small.
packs.requestHint: GBIF takes minutes to hours to prepare the file; when it is done, download it here and import it.
packs.importHint: A species list downloaded on gbif.org (Species list format, zip) can be imported directly.
packs.waiting: GBIF is working ({{status}}), waiting {{elapsed}}. Checked automatically while this page is open.
packs.pending: Waiting for GBIF. Tap “Resume” to check again.
packs.fileReadyHint: Tap “Download file” to save it to this device, then “Import a downloaded file” and pick that zip.
packs.notSpeciesList: This is not a GBIF species list file: {{msg}}
packs.passwordNotSaved: The password is used for this request only and is not saved on this device.
packs.notifyHint: Optional. GBIF emails this address when the file is ready.
packs.register: No GBIF account yet? Register for free at gbif.org
